text:
Sana: Heads up — cut is blocked, deploy-bot keeps failing the final promote step for canary -> prod.
Sana: CI jobs are erroring during artifact restore, multiple runners show symlink/permission issues extracting the archive.
Ravi: I'm seeing this in bk: artifact unpack fails with `Operation not permitted` when creating symlinks under node_modules.
Ravi: failing log excerpt:
```
+ tar -xzf release-artifacts.tgz
tar: ./node_modules/.bin -> ../.bin: Cannot create symlink
Error: unpack failed
```
Taylor: We just rolled an automerged kernel patch onto the staging cache hosts earlier; that's my hunch too.
Taylor: Options: revert kernel across runners (disruptive, ~25m) OR promote last-known-good and follow up.
ops-jen: Oncall. Confirmed widespread cache restore errors in us-west and eu-west. Kernel bump happened 12:14UTC.
ops-jen: Rolling revert during the change window risks destabilizing more builds. Recommend manual promote to meet release SLA.
Sana: If we manual promote, we need a clear audit trail and release note entry explaining the pin. Who can run it?
Ravi: I can do the manual promote and update release notes. My promote command will be:
```
/deploy promote --image sha:5c3b2a --env prod --reason "pin-due-to-cache-untar-perm-fail"
```
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt blocked by artifact-index lease timeout: lease_acquire_timeout. Details: `indexer=artifact-index-03` `retries=4`
qa-bot: QA here — if we pinch to previous sha please run quick regression smoke on the affected flows (auth, uploads). I can queue those once promoted.
Taylor: I'll file infra follow-up and include job ids and host list. Ops, please capture kernel diff and mount options.
ops-jen: Opening ticket INFRA-2030. Attaching failing job ids: bk/2045,bk/2077,bk/2099 and node list.
Sana: Ok proceeding with manual promote so we don't miss the window. Ravi please run and confirm.
Ravi: Executing promote now.
Ravi: /deploy promote --image sha:5c3b2a --env prod --reason "pin-due-to-cache-untar-perm-fail"
deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by Ravi. Performing rollout to prod replicas.
deploy-bot: Rollout in progress -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%. Health checks passing.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. prod image sha:5c3b2a. Health: OK. :white_check_mark:
qa-bot: Kicking off quick smoke suite against prod, will report back in ~10m.
Sana: Thanks. Ravi please add detailed note in release notes: pinned sha, reasoning, INFRA-2030 link, and next steps for infra revert.
Ravi: Will do. Release note draft: "Pinned to sha:5c3b2a due to CI artifact extraction failures (symlink perms) after kernel update on cache hosts. Infra ticket INFRA-2030 opened; QA smoke queued."
Taylor: Also adding a checklist item to prevent auto-kernel-merges during active change windows.
ops-jen: INFRA-2030 created, assigning to infra kernel team. I'll coordinate rollback plan for off-window.
Sana: Good. Closing the cut thread — follow-ups tracked. Thanks all for quick triage.
__notes: Slack threads are a single continuous string of messages in chronological order, messages prefixed with sender name
